dict.string: DeepSeek Harness reads and writes files in the workspace you choose, which may be in your Documents folder.
DeepSeek Harness reads and writes files in the workspace you choose, which may be on your Desktop.
DeepSeek Harness reads and writes files in the workspace you choose, which may be in your Downloads folder.
DeepSeek Harness reads and writes files in the workspace you choose, which may be on a removable volume.
DeepSeek Harness reads and writes files in the workspace you choose, which may be on a network volume.
DeepSeek Harness uses a system dialog to let you pick a workspace directory.
